XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: - -

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated, with reduced performance and occasional significant difficulty starting.

  • Faults detected by self-diagnosis: P0016 (Crankshaft position/phase 1, bank 1 – Incorrect ratio)

  • Cause: Engine out of phase

• Procedure: Check the integrity and condition of the timing kit components; if no damage or wear is found, you can proceed with restoring the correct engine timing. Otherwise, you will need to replace the damaged/worn components or the timing kit.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, it was necessary to realign the engine, thereby permanently resolving the fault.
    Problems of this kind are quite common with this engine.
